{{Youmay|the [[Pre-Republic era]] prototype design|the [[AB-1 Landspeeder]]}}
{{Quote|Also surviving was the original AB-1 'floatcoach,' the prototype of the landspeeder design in service today.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="FR">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''AB-1 "floatcoach"''' was an early prototype of modern [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] produced in the time before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FR" /> [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept several of these vehicles in the [[Hangar Bay|hangar bay]] of his [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] storehouse.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|5|AB-1 "floatcoach"}}</ref>
